title: Chapter 252
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

A genius will remember 'Love Go Go Small' in one second. You will be able to read a lot of interesting novels.

"These things can last you about five days. Eat sparingly. If you hear the Germinal Organization's search team nearby, don't make a sound," Han Xiao reminded her.

Aurora nodded timidly. She buried her head between her knees and stared at the two of them as they left. Suddenly, she said, "Sister, I'll wait for you to pick me up."

Hella paused for a moment. She took a deep breath and steeled her heart before walking out.

Han Xiao disguised the entrance of the cave and left a GPS tracker. He let Hella drive while he cleaned up the tracks behind the car. The Germinal Organization's people would not be able to follow this route through the tracks.

After returning to the main road, Han Xiao returned to the car. Hella turned around and looked at him with burning eyes. "Are you really confident?"

Han Xiao nodded.

"I don't joke about my life."

Hella was silent for a while. Suddenly, she said, "If I die, I'll leave my sister to you. With your strength, the chances of you escaping alone are higher than mine."

"If you use that tone to say a few more words, you might really die."

Han Xiao stared at her with his eyes that had disappeared for a long time.

Although he complained, he understood Hella's feelings. For her, every step she took now was full of danger. She was not as strong as he was, and she did not know what the future would be like. She only had her sister. She put her heart and soul into Aurora, and was even willing to sacrifice her life for her sister. Therefore, she became pessimistic about her own fate.

However, saying these words also meant that Han Xiao had completely won Hella's trust. This was the goal he had set when he first got involved in this matter.

"I've contacted the reinforcements from the Six Nations. They're already nearby. I've agreed on a location with them. If we fail to break out tomorrow, we still have reinforcements. If everything goes well, we don't even need reinforcements to break out."

"I hope so."

Hella looked at Han Xiao and did not say anything.

…

An hour later, the car stopped at a secluded hill.

"There are still 10 hours until the agreed time. The direction of the breakout is to the east. The plan is like this …" Han Xiao took out Viper and placed it in front of Hella. "You will use this mecha. In these 10 hours, you must familiarize yourself with how to use the various weapons on the mecha."

Hella was shocked. "What about you?"

"If we want to break out of the encirclement, we'll have to cause a commotion. I'll go blow up their vehicles and ammunition. They'll definitely be on guard against my disguise equipment, but I have an invisibility ability." Han Xiao was naturally referring to the Dion Character Summon Card that he had used once at the headquarters.

Hella understood. "That's why I used the mecha to disguise myself as you to attract the enemy's attention. That's because you're their most important target."

Han Xiao nodded. This tactic made use of inertial thinking and sneaking around. It wasn't brilliant, but it was effective.

He adjusted the mecha, gave Hella access, and taught her how to put it on.

After putting on the mecha, it was a whole new experience. Looking at the outside world through the display screen, it was as if a door to a new world had been opened. Hella tried to move her arms and legs, and found that there was extra strength. Following Han Xiao's instructions, she called out the various controls of the mecha on the built-in screen. It was very complicated and dazzling.

"So complicated … did you make all this?" Hella's tone was slightly surprised.

"Did it fall from the sky?" Han Xiao said in annoyance.

Han Xiao guided Hella to familiarize herself with Viper's controls. Hella knew that time was tight, so she put in a lot of effort to learn.

Han Xiao did not need her to familiarize herself with the mecha. He only needed her to be able to hold on for a while under siege.

The night faded and the sun rose. Time passed quickly during the training.

The two of them did not sleep the entire night.

Han Xiao looked at the sky and said, "It's about time. Don't take off the mecha. Remember the plan and don't make any mistakes."

…
